channel.title: General Availability on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in General Availability on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Windows Server 2025 on AKS
item.description:
AKS now supports Windows Server 2025 in general availability, giving customers a newer Windows node option for Windows-based Kubernetes workloads on Azure. This is intended to help with modernization as older Windows Server versions near retirement.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential VMs for Azure Linux
item.description:
Confidential Virtual Machines for Azure Linux in AKS are now generally available. This adds CVM node pool support for migrating highly sensitive container workloads to AKS.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Auxiliary Logs Plan in Azure Government and China regions
item.description:
Azure Monitor Auxiliary Logs Plan is now generally available in Azure Government (Fairfax) and China regions. The plan is intended for cost-effective ingestion and retention of high-volume, verbose logs for compliance and auditing.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Claude Fable 5.1 from Anthropic is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for long-horizon, autonomous coding and knowledge-work tasks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Better label management on issues is generally available
item.description:
GitHub says improved label management for issues is now generally available. The update is aimed at making labels easier to organize and find in repositories with large or growing label lists.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Rule insights dashboard generally available
item.description:
The rule insights dashboard is now generally available for both repositories and organizations. It provides a visual, high-level view of how GitHub evaluates and enforces repository rules.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension
item.description:
Azure SQL Database provisioning in the MSSQL extension is now generally available. Users can create and connect to a managed Azure SQL Database from their editor, with ARM, Bicep, and Terraform templates included.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: vCore Customization: Disable Multithreading and Configurable Constrained Cores
item.description:
Azure Virtual Machines vCore Customization is now generally available. The update adds support for disabling SMT/Hyper-Threading and for configuring constrained core counts on supported VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed Instance on Azure App Service
item.description:
Managed Instance on Azure App Service is now generally available. It is intended to help migrate web applications from on-premises or virtual machines to Azure App Service with minimal configuration and no code changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Pre-upgrade validation checks for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Pre-upgrade validation checks for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server are now generally available. They let you verify major version upgrade readiness before starting the upgrade.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot code review effort levels are generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review effort levels are now generally available. Lite and Balanced let you choose review depth based on the complexity and risk of the code change.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SharePoint Connector for Azure Databricks
item.description:
The SharePoint connector for Azure Databricks is now generally available. It can be used through Lakeflow Connect to ingest files from SharePoint into Azure Databricks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Automation supports PowerShell 7.6 runbooks and Runtime environment
item.description:
Azure Automation now generally supports PowerShell 7.6 runbooks and the Runtime environment. This lets customers move scripts to a supported runtime version, with Azure CLI command support also mentioned in the update.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Code Quality is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team. The announcement says it is intended to help with the growing volume of code produced with AI assistance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Agent Harness in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now has general availability for Agent Harness, the production runtime for agents built with the framework. Preview harness users can move the same agent code into production with backward compatibility.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: New pull requests dashboard is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub’s refreshed pull requests dashboard is now generally available at github.com/pulls. It provides a single place to track, prioritize, and act on pull requests that need attention.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning extended metadata and multipart validation
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now surfaces extended metadata for supported secret types to help identify ownership and impact of leaked secrets. The update also includes general availability of extended metadata checks and multipart validation support.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Issue fields are now generally available
item.description:
Issue fields are now generally available for all GitHub organizations on Free, Team, Enterprise, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency plans. Support will also ship in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Kimi K2.7 Code is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Kimi K2.7 Code is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is the first open-weight model available as a selectable option in the Copilot model picker.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Document PII NextGen Playground in Azure AI Language
item.description:
Azure AI Language’s Document PII NextGen Playground is now generally available. It provides a refreshed experience for evaluating document PII detection with curated sample inputs and outputs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are generally available
item.description:
Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are now generally available. GitHub also clarified which permissions remain under user control and noted that existing network domain controls still apply.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot for Jira is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for Jira is now generally available after a public preview that began in March 2026. GitHub says it has added several improvements since preview, including model selection.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot CLI: New terminal interface is generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI’s redesigned terminal interface is now generally available. It adds a tabbed layout for working with GitHub directly from the terminal.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Auto mode in Copilot Chat available for all users
item.description:
GitHub Copilot auto model selection is now generally available in Copilot Chat on github.com and the GitHub mobile app for all Copilot plans. In auto mode, Copilot selects the model for the chat request.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.21 is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.21 is now generally available. The release adds improvements in deployment efficiency, monitoring, code security, and policy management, including organization custom properties now generally available.

  • Source: GitHub
